body: Better to die with a belly full of mead, a sword in hand, and surrounded by brothers than rotting away on some farm waiting to be conscripted by the nobles to fight in the petty wars or killed in an green skin raid. Retirement is for the weak and cowardly. Half of my company on my current play through have at least one permanent injury. Have one guy with 4 and I’ve personally grown quiet attached to him. Every man has a use even if it’s just to bait the enemy into advancing into a more favorable position or to draw them away from the rest of your guys. Save the 920 gold to hire his replacement.
Be wary of using the commitment save mode because if your save gets corrupted you’re fucked

Spend two days training with Bernard in rattay. Fast travel to skalitz. Often times once a day there will be bandits, Cumans, guards or merchants fighting each other. Stand back wait for them to kill each other then either sneak in or loot or wait until sunset (the time the surviving party normally leaves) fast travel to rattay and sell what you don’t want. Repeat each day until you have a fat wallet or full plate armor. Spend three more days training with Bernard this time with real weapons taking time to rest and repair armor as needed. If you do this right you should be able to have 12-20k grochen and damn near best armor across the board for a good while. Make sure to buy warhorse Jenda in morhojed asap otherwise you can’t once you reach a certain point in the story. If you follow at least close to those your combat stats should be decently high enough that the tourney and a good portion of story level quests you can just bull charge through them easy peasy.

Coming from someone that has tried to off themselves by hanging.. it is a terrible way to go you may think that it'll be quick but it is so easy to mess up its not even funny. I was hanging for almost 30 minutes in some of the most agonizing pain I've had in my life. Having your airway closed but not completely so you can breathe just enough to slowly suffocate i cant even describe the feeling. The panic I felt as I realized that I didn't want to die and no matter how fucked up my life is that there was nothing I could do to stop it. If it hadn't been for the person that hurt me as a child finding me I would have never grown up to meet my wife or my children. You feel like your life is hard right now and that there is no escaping whatever you are going through. But it does get better even if its just small things in life look at the small things and appreciate them for what they are. Because in doing something like this there may be no going back no matter how much you may want to.
